name: Rank list
summary: Put the options in order on the audience phone: frosted rows with a live ordinal badge, move-up and move-down buttons for the keyboard, and a pointer drag.
highlights: Ordering / ranking input for the audience phone
Live ordinal badge in the deck accent
Keyboard move buttons plus a pointer drag
Every move announced to a screen reader
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-rank-list> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: the answer row's surface: min-height 44, padding 8/16, radius 8, frosted, 1px ink hairline; 16px semibold label; an option image as a 28px thumbnail (radius 6)

spec.label: Badge
spec.value: 24px circle in the deck accent, white 12px semibold numeral, renumbers live

spec.label: Move
spec.value: 24px up / down buttons with 12px carets (system-caret-up / -down) in the muted ink, disabled at the ends; system-drag grip for the pointer

spec.label: Drag
spec.value: the row follows the finger; siblings slide out of its way (FLIP, motion tokens); no motion under reduced motion

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: lock-key
props.desc: The submission-lock key for this question: once a submission is locked under it, the element locks and restores the submitted value, including after an iframe remount

props.name: options
props.desc: The options to order. Also the `options` property

props.name: value
props.desc: The ordered ids. Also the `value` property

props.name: group-label
props.desc: The list's accessible name and a muted 12px caption above the rows: pass the translated question

props.name: change
props.desc: Fires on every move with the new order

whenToUse.when: the participant puts a short list in order (ranking, sequencing)
the participant picks rather than orders

opinion.note: The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the light-deck example with no deck applied (DS defaults).
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-rank-list[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;function q(s){return r&&r.querySelector(s)}function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var row=q('.row');var c=cs(row);return{rowHeight:c.height,rowRadius:c.borderTopLeftRadius,ink:c.color,badge:cs(q('.badge')).backgroundColor,labelSize:cs(q('.label')).fontSize,gap:cs(q('.list')).rowGap};})()
